buildProvenance: Validated working tree after sourceBase; compiled Git metadata still names the pre-commit base. Final publication commit identifies the tested patch.

coldRestart.scenario: unsent draft background -> force-stop -> cold relaunch

atRest.boundary: Existing AES-GCM/AndroidKeystore AtomicFile path; valid opaque frame plus UI decrypt/readback. No credential files read.

coldRestart.boundary: Two seconds were allowed for async save before stopping; this does not eliminate a precommit loss window.

sharedEditorsAndRotation.boundary: Returning to free sensor policy need not itself rotate a stationary flat device; portrait was explicitly measured before restoring original policy.

limitations: Atomic acknowledgements follow disk commit; uncommitted edits can be lost if the process is stopped before async completion.
Blocked-write restore/delete races, corrupt-byte preservation, size bounds and write-failure recovery are unit-tested; no deliberate corruption of live user storage was performed.
Native and human voice boundaries remain separate.
